Current authority includes owner-verified Admin batch creation and Portal Login Details, Replace Resource, quiz-bridge shared-Worker composition, Year 6 SAT direct-release semantics, authoritative Y6SM CSV/display mapping, server-authoritative Maths equivalent Year/L-level navigation, manual parent-email delivery, and the permanent forward-only production-recovery rule.

restartInstruction: Read the complete authority set above before diagnosing or changing Portal/Admin behaviour. Freshly prove current main, live route, deployed Worker composition, bindings and data-store ownership. Preserve every shared Worker capability. Production recovery is FORWARD-ONLY: never revert, restore an older Worker, use wrangler rollback, or deploy an older entrypoint to recover one feature. If current-state preservation cannot be proved, fail closed and diagnose before mutation. Update this manifest and the applicable authority file in the same coherent change whenever authority or workflow behaviour changes.

nonNegotiableCompletionRule: No student-visible Admin/source mutation is complete merely because its canonical source write succeeded. Creating a batch is distinct from creating a student login. A generic SQL constraint failure must never be presented as a duplicate batch. Portal Login Details Find remains read-only. Reset & Show New Credentials is a separate deliberate action that may replace only the normal student's Login and Answer Pack credential fields and must preserve batches, entitlements, sessions and account state. Frontend module paths must be verified in browser-relative context. Parent-email test routing must never consume live-parent idempotency. Equivalent Maths Year/L-level cards must not be duplicated in the student home presentation. Production recovery must never roll back later valid changes.
